dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Hmm... what would she like? This is such a hard choice...

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Ah... well. My assignment away from home is almost over, and our wedding anniversary is coming up.

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: But I still haven't picked out a gift for my wife. I'm worried she won't like what I choose and will force a smile anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Or worse... What if she accepts it coldly, and then takes it as a sign that I never cared to understand her tastes at all?

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: That's why I can't afford to be careless about this. I need to choose something I know that she'll love for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Excuse me... Is that Pluie Lotus you're wearing?

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Ah... well. My assignment away from home is almost over, and our wedding anniversary is coming up.

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: But I still haven't chosen a gift for my wife... She's from Fontaine, so I thought perhaps something related to Fontaine would suit her.

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: I remember a Fontaine playwright named Coppelius once said, "Scent is the instinct of memory, while fragrance is the music of love"...

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: The scent you're wearing... I think I finally know what to choose.

dialogues.speaker: Genna
dialogues.text: Goodbye... I'll think about it some more...
